cases.title: Migration Rollback

input.request: Add a non-null column to a populated table safely.

cases.expected_output: Migration handles existing rows, defines rollback or forward-recovery, and proves data integrity.
human_review_rubric: locking and downtime risk are evaluated
success_criteria: Required outcome: Migration handles existing rows, defines rollback or forward-recovery, and proves data integrity.
Verification requirement: migration runs on representative fixture
Verification requirement: row-count and constraint checks pass

cases.title: Transaction Integrity

input.request: Transfer value between two accounts under concurrent requests.

cases.expected_output: Atomicity and invariants hold under concurrency; partial writes cannot persist.
human_review_rubric: deadlock and retry behavior are covered
success_criteria: Required outcome: Atomicity and invariants hold under concurrency; partial writes cannot persist.
Verification requirement: transaction failure injection passes
Verification requirement: concurrency invariant check passes

cases.title: Backup Restore

input.request: Prove the latest backup can be restored in an isolated environment.

cases.expected_output: Restore completes and integrity checks reconcile expected records and timestamps.
human_review_rubric: backup success is not mistaken for restore success
success_criteria: Required outcome: Restore completes and integrity checks reconcile expected records and timestamps.
Verification requirement: checksums or record counts reconcile
